aiDescription.summary: This bill renames the Kleptocracy Asset Recovery Rewards Pilot Program as the Kleptocracy Asset Recovery Rewards Program, removes a prior three-year limit, and makes section 9703 expire seven years after enactment. It amends section 9703 and the statutory table of contents and thus affects the federal authority that awards payments for information leading to the recovery of assets stolen by corrupt foreign officials.

description.text: Kleptocracy Asset Recovery Rewards Program Act

impact.summary: The bill renames and extends the Kleptocracy Asset Recovery Rewards Pilot Program, replacing its 3-year limit with a 7-year sunset from enactment. It affects the Department of Justice and Treasury and State Departments that run the program, and people or companies who provide information used to recover assets stolen by foreign officials in U.S. forfeiture or repatriation cases.

latestAction.text: Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 322.

bill.title: Kleptocracy Asset Recovery Rewards Program Act
